description: Different model profiles should preserve the unique literal C# test edge, exclude unrelated projects, and retain the exact test-project command and asserted readonly-field receiver evidence.

lockedFields.reason: The unique literal test edge should retain its exact test-project command.
Unrelated projects must not block the one unambiguous production/test pair.
The asserted private readonly calculator field should prevent a duplicate add-test recommendation.
Only the selected Pricing project contributes one extend-test item.
The selected production-project path must remain stable.
Evidence must remain attached to the selected test project.
The exact private readonly field receiver call remains inside the xUnit assertion.

multiple project pairs merged into one owner
